secrets.name: AUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: Signs admin session cookies for the AliLand API. Required for administrator login to stay valid across restarts.

secrets.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Password for the seeded admin account (ADMIN_EMAIL, default admin@aliland.demo). Optional: when unset the demo seed uses the built-in portfolio password and the login screen labels itself as a demo account. Set it before any real use.
